package langchain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestZZUGen(t *testing.T) {
	in := os.Getenv("LC_UIN")
	if in == "" {
		t.Skip()
	}
	data, _ := os.ReadFile(in)
	var cases map[string]struct {
		Events []interface{}          `json:"events"`
		State  int                    `json:"state"`
		Seed   map[string]interface{} `json:"seed"`
		Kind   string                 `json:"kind"`
		State0 map[string]interface{} `json:"state0"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(cases))
	for k := range cases {
		keys = append(keys, k)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys) // calls #L0,#L1.. in order (single digit assumption checked below)
	states := map[string]*eventState{}
	out := map[string]interface{}{}
	for _, k := range keys {
		c := cases[k]
		if c.Kind == "model" {
			test := k[:strings.LastIndex(k, "#")]
			st := states["M:"+test]
			fresh := st == nil
			if fresh {
				st = newEventState()
				states["M:"+test] = st
			}
			s0 := c.State0
			mid, _ := s0["messageId"].(string)
			if !fresh {
				s0 = map[string]interface{}{}
			} else {
				st.streamStarted, _ = s0["started"].(bool)
				st.streamMessageID = mid
			}
			if v, _ := s0["reasoningStarted"].(bool); v {
				st.streamReasoningStarted = true
				st.streamReasoningID = mid
				if r, ok := s0["reasoningMessageId"].(string); ok {
					st.streamReasoningID = r
				}
			}
			if v, _ := s0["textStarted"].(bool); v {
				st.streamTextStarted = true
				st.streamTextID = mid
				if r, ok := s0["textMessageId"].(string); ok {
					st.streamTextID = r
				}
			}
			chunks := processModelChunk(st, c.Events[0])
			b, _ := json.Marshal(chunks)
			var norm interface{}
			_ = json.Unmarshal(b, &norm)
			if norm == nil {
				norm = []interface{}{}
			}
			out[k] = norm
			continue
		}
		if c.Kind != "lang" {
			continue
		}
		test := k[:strings.LastIndex(k, "#")]
		skey := test
		_ = c.State
		st := states[skey]
		if st == nil {
			st = newEventState()
			states[skey] = st
			for name, v := range c.Seed {
				arr, _ := v.([]interface{})
				for _, it := range arr {
					switch name {
					case "emittedToolCalls":
						st.emittedToolCalls[it.(string)] = true
					case "emittedImages":
						st.emittedImages[it.(string)] = true
					case "emittedReasoningIds":
						st.emittedReasoningIDs[it.(string)] = true
					case "messageSeen":
						p := it.([]interface{})
						ms := &messageSeenState{}
						m := p[1].(map[string]interface{})
						ms.text, _ = m["text"].(bool)
						ms.reasoning, _ = m["reasoning"].(bool)
						st.messageSeen[p[0].(string)] = ms
						st.messageOrder = append(st.messageOrder, p[0].(string))
					case "currentStepsByNamespace":
						p := it.([]interface{})
						st.currentStepsByNamespace[p[0].(string)] = int(p[1].(float64))
					case "emittedToolCallsByKey":
						p := it.([]interface{})
						key := p[0].(string)
						i := strings.Index(key, ":")
						var args interface{}
						_ = json.Unmarshal([]byte(key[i+1:]), &args)
						st.emittedToolCallsByKey[toolCallKey(key[:i], args)] = p[1].(string)
					default:
						t.Fatalf("unhandled seed %s", name)
					}
				}
			}
		}
		tuple := c.Events[0].([]interface{})
		chunks := processLangGraphEvent(st, ParseLangGraphEvent(tuple))
		b, _ := json.Marshal(chunks)
		var norm interface{}
		_ = json.Unmarshal(b, &norm)
		if norm == nil {
			norm = []interface{}{}
		}
		out[k] = norm
	}
	b, _ := json.Marshal(out)
	_ = os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("LC_OUT"), b, 0o644)
}
